research_question: Can a physically recorded early photonic measurement A be statistically dependent on an independently chosen later measurement setting B without postselection, forward leakage or chronological ambiguity?

direct_empirical_precedent.title: Experimental delayed-choice entanglement swapping
direct_empirical_precedent.evidenced_claim: Real experimental arrangement with earlier registrations of photons 1 and 4, later quantum RNG decision between Bell-state and separable-state measurements on photons 2 and 3, with choice made in the timelike future of the early detections.
hardware_in_paper: 104 m optical fiber delay for photons 2 and 3
direct_empirical_precedent.interpretation: Quantum correlations grouped by later measurements; paper does not demonstrate that an early observer can read a future message unconditionally.
direct_empirical_precedent.note_on_sampling: Original entanglement-swapping coincidence-based analysis is not a substitute for JANUS primary no-postselection trial accounting.

modern_context.title: Existence of processes violating causal inequalities on time-delocalised subsystems
modern_context.role: Theoretical model for time-delocalised subsystems; not a timestamped backwards message.

modern_context.title: Experimental violation of a Bell-like inequality for causal order
modern_context.role: Photonic quantum-switch Bell-like inequality violation, with acknowledged assumptions/loopholes; does not realize bipartite OCB W or future-to-past communication.

modern_context.title: Experimental violation of a Bell-like causal inequality in a photonic quantum switch
modern_context.role: 24-sigma Bell-like witness with remaining loopholes, distinct from proof of past-directed channel.

janus_proposed_instrument.tier_1_minimal: Entangled photon pair; record Alice's fixed-basis measurement a and hardware timestamp; store other photon in optical delay; afterwards let independent hardware QRNG select Bob's Z or X measurement via fast optical modulator. This tests unconditional independence of early a from future freely selected b. Secondary analysis: Alice/Bob outcome correlations after both records exist.
janus_proposed_instrument.tier_2_precise_replication: Four-photon two-source delayed-choice entanglement swapping akin to Ma et al.; Alice and Bob early detections, delayed photon pair and future QRNG-selectable Bell-state/separable-state analyzer. Requires established quantum-optics laboratory and timing control.

preregistration_proposal_not_activated.trial_unit: Pre-clocked source emission attempt or independently validated event-ready source attempt; record even when no early or late detector click.
preregistration_proposal_not_activated.chronology_gate: Require independently calibrated hardware chronology t_B_QRNG_generation > t_A_hardware + epsilon_timing; latch/clock evidence independently audited. Do not mistake later Git timestamp for nanosecond chronology.
preregistration_proposal_not_activated.randomness_gate: Fresh per-trial hardware entropy for B is generated only after t_A, no shared pseudorandom seed, lookahead, communication path, adaptive trigger keyed to A outcome, or access from early logger. Audit B's balance/serial dependence.
preregistration_proposal_not_activated.unconditional_primary: Freeze an early-only decoder that outputs one bit prediction of later B on every trial, including early no-click, before any future choice exists; count every trial and compare to independent uniform B null P(correct)=1/2 using a preregistered fixed-N analysis. Primary is NOT conditional on late detection/herald or coincidence.
preregistration_proposal_not_activated.crosscheck_primary: Compare empirical P(A_raw|B=0) and P(A_raw|B=1) for complete trinary raw early alphabet (0,1,no_click). Predefine tests and account for trial independence, detector drift and repeated look effects.
preregistration_proposal_not_activated.secondary_only: After both logs are closed compare Bell correlations, setting-conditioned subensembles, delayed-choice entanglement-witness and efficiency. Never promote late-herald-selected coincidences to earlier-accessible information.
preregistration_proposal_not_activated.abort_policy: Retain every scheduled trial and error. Mark INFRA_ABORT according to fixed timing/device faults only; never outcome-conditioned retry or exclusion.
security_controls: Separate early logger and later QRNG credentials, network paths and clocks
Read-only sealed early log; cryptographic hash chain and independent later verification
Calibrate timing-jitter margin before examining target data
Leakage-positive control must be detected and rejected

technical_boundary.standard_quantum_prediction: Future local trace-preserving operations do not change earlier local reduced state; no unconditional future-to-past signalling in ordinary QM.
technical_boundary.operational_witness: D_TV(P(A_raw|B=0), P(A_raw|B=1)) for complete early outcomes, not late-herald-selected subsets.
technical_boundary.future_byte_campaign_interaction: Independent experimental lane; must not pool statistics or alter existing historical records of Retro Byte Campaign.
technical_boundary.training_policy: No use of late-herald-selected correlations, theoretical OCB game outputs or ideal CTC fixed points as real retrocausal labels.

next_action: Collaborate with or obtain authorized access to a quantum-optics laboratory with delayed photonic measurements and independently audited hardware QRNG; preregister exact fixed sample size, timestamps, baseline, inclusion criteria, and independent replication before collecting target data.
